title: Black Hibiscus - Basquiat
htmlContent:
Nigerian-born indie-soul artist Black Hibiscus drops a new single, "Basquiat," the second single of his upcoming EP "The End of the World," a unique fancy of what we can look forward to thematically with the whole project. The entire project, "The End of the World," displays themes of love and loss.

The production has a solid R&B sound that has a nice touch to set the leading style for the heart put into the music, a record with an approach that music fans everywhere love. It's not only a record that sounds good to the whole but also a record that gives you personal knowledge of music that creates perfection to carry the listener on a voyage that will be worth the hear every time.
